description: Ubuntu 24.04 VPS on Railway with OpenSSH and a stable TCP Proxy. Log in with an SSH key (recommended) or the root password. Auto-start API servers / AI agents.
name: Railway Ubuntu SSH VPS

PASSWORD_AUTH.description: yes/no/auto — Allow SSH password login. auto (default): disable password auth when an SSH key is present.

ROOT_PASSWORD.description: Root password for SSH. Leave empty to auto-generate a strong 24-character password (see the first deploy log). Setting your own is recommended.

SSH_PUB_KEY.description: SSH public key (RECOMMENDED). When a key is loaded, password authentication is AUTOMATICALLY DISABLED to stop brute-force attacks.

START_COMMAND.description: Command to run on container start. E.g.: uvicorn main:app --host 0.0.0.0 --port ${PORT:-8080}. Logs at /var/log/railway-vps/app.log.
